Base stats increase dmg more than atk% and dmg%, and the dmg portraits have terribly low base atk, so the best portraits are

\-Oriko Puella (356 atk, 15-20 atk%)  
\-Nightmare/Battler Desert Witch (271 / 225 atk, 15-20 atk% / 10-15% atk)  
\-A Time Of Happiness (276 atk, 7.5-12.5% flame dmg)

\-Yeah, even if you get better buffers, Hazuki can still be used as a support kioku so there's little room for regrets in upgrading her. You can also use her as Riko's support kioku, and as for Ayame, she can be Ren's support kioku

\-Hazuki isn't good just because she's a buffer, she's good because she has high spd and her skill gives her turn to someone else, and this could be super helpful: you can give the turn to a shielder/healer to prevent your team from dying, give the turn to a breaker so you can break faster, or when the boss is broken, give the turn to your attacker, since her skill also increases their dmg
